subject: Bison bison
creator: Kayt Jonsson/USFWS
alt: A bison stands in a cloud of sunlit dust among reclining members of the herd.
detail: A large bison stands broadside in suspended, backlit dust among several reclining bison in a grassy field. Other bison are visible farther back. Dark foreground bodies contrast with warm dust; distant human structures are visible.
